assertions.name: pslq_searched_every_basis_element
assertions.source: Pairwise PSLQ at maxcoeff 10⁶ returned — rather than raising into the loop's `except: pass` — for every basis element, so the NULL verdict reflects completed searches.

assertions.name: pslq_ran_at_declared_precision
assertions.source: Working precision at witness time is at least the declared 120 dps; the 'higher-precision' claim in this probe's name is exactly this.

description: Task 2 of PR #1629: higher-precision (120 dps) PSLQ search for the h⁴-residual coefficient (target ≈ 0.876580096) across 17 natural substrate basis elements. Tests pairwise (maxcoeff 10⁶) and full basis (maxcoeff 100).

data.verdict: NULL — no clean PSLQ integer relations at higher precision. The h⁴-residual coefficient is NOT a rational multiple of any single basis element in {G, π², ζ(3), ln(2), ...}. Best N for `1 - π²/N` form: N = 200 (Δ = -775647.0 ppm). Exact N = -3.04870813991 — NOT clean integer 80.
